description: A deterministic open benchmark for observable control-event classification contracts.
claim_boundary: This benchmark scores classification contract behavior on synthetic observable events only; it does not measure agent quality, establish causation, or prove universal safety.

cases.evidence_boundary: Synthetic completion and passing-test markers support only the observable converging label.
Repeated synthetic tool signatures and a guard marker support only the observable stalled label.
Alternating synthetic test outcomes support only the observable oscillating label.
Synthetic retry, error, and resource-growth events support only the observable diverging label.
One synthetic request is below the evidence threshold, so no stronger label is supported.
